title: Learning to Verify: Signature-Guided Training for Adaptive Adversarial Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.25271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adversarial example detectors often fail when attackers explicitly attempt to bypass them. We propose a dual-model approach that keeps the original classifier fixed and trains a separate verifier to assess its predictions. During training, we identify patterns of internal neural network activations that distinguish genuine examples of each class from adversarial examples targeting that class. These patterns, called activation signatures, guide the generation of challenging adversarial examples that mislead the classifier, challenge the verifier, and internally resemble the target class. The verifier learns to recognize these examples while preserving its performance on clean inputs through knowledge distillation. At inference, the verifier evaluates the classifier's prediction without requiring activation signatures. translated_title: 学习验证：面向自适应对抗检测的签名引导训练
translated_abstract: 当攻击者明确试图绕过检测器时，对抗样本检测器往往会失效。我们提出一种双模型方法，即保持原始分类器固定不变，并训练一个独立的验证器来评估分类器的预测结果。在训练过程中，我们识别出神经网络内部激活中的模式，这些模式能够区分每个类别的真实样本与针对该类别的对抗样本。这些被称为“激活签名”的模式可指导生成具有挑战性的对抗样本，这类样本既能误导分类器、又能挑战验证器，且在内部特征上与目标类别相似。验证器通过知识蒸馏学习识别这些对抗样本，同时保持其在干净输入上的性能。在推理阶段，验证器无需激活签名即可评估分类器的预测结果。我们在公开数据集上针对多种自适应攻击评估了该方法，包括训练中未见过的攻击……
tldr: 该论文提出一种双模型对抗检测方法：固定原始分类器并训练独立验证器，利用“激活签名”引导生成能同时误导分类器、挑战验证器且内部特征接近目标类别的高难度对抗样本进行训练，使验证器在面对自适应攻击（含未见过的攻击）时依然有效，且推理时无需激活签名。
en_tdlr: A dual-model approach that keeps the original classifier fixed and trains a separate verifier guided by activation signatures to generate challenging adversarial examples, enabling robust detection against adaptive and unseen attacks without requiring activation signatures at inference.
